name: @ahegyes/wordpress-plugins
description: DWS WordPress plugins monorepo — the shared test environment and the plugins' fan-outs.

scripts.setup: npm run packages-install:all && npm run plugins:build
scripts.setup:ci: composer plugins:packages-install && npm run plugins:packages-install:ci && npm run plugins:build
scripts.packages-install:all: composer packages-install && composer plugins:packages-install && npm run packages-install && npm run plugins:packages-install
scripts.packages-update:all: composer packages-update && composer plugins:packages-update && npm run packages-update && npm run plugins:packages-update && npm run packages-update:wp && npm run plugins:packages-update:wp
scripts.plugins:packages-install: npm --prefix=plugins/linked-orders-for-woocommerce run packages-install && npm --prefix=plugins/internal-comments run packages-install && npm --prefix=plugins/locked-payment-methods-for-woocommerce run packages-install
scripts.plugins:packages-update: npm --prefix=plugins/linked-orders-for-woocommerce run packages-update && npm --prefix=plugins/internal-comments run packages-update && npm --prefix=plugins/locked-payment-methods-for-woocommerce run packages-update
scripts.plugins:packages-update:wp: npm --prefix=plugins/linked-orders-for-woocommerce run packages-update:wp && npm --prefix=plugins/internal-comments run packages-update:wp && npm --prefix=plugins/locked-payment-methods-for-woocommerce run packages-update:wp
scripts.plugins:packages-install:ci: npm --prefix=plugins/linked-orders-for-woocommerce ci && npm --prefix=plugins/internal-comments ci && npm --prefix=plugins/locked-payment-methods-for-woocommerce ci
scripts.plugins:build: npm --prefix=plugins/linked-orders-for-woocommerce run build && npm --prefix=plugins/internal-comments run build && npm --prefix=plugins/locked-payment-methods-for-woocommerce run build
scripts.lint: npm run lint:scripts && npm run lint:types
scripts.plugins:lint: npm --prefix=plugins/linked-orders-for-woocommerce run lint && npm --prefix=plugins/internal-comments run lint && npm --prefix=plugins/locked-payment-methods-for-woocommerce run lint
scripts.lint:all: npm run lint && composer plugins:lint:php && npm run plugins:lint
scripts.plugins:test:e2e: npm --prefix=plugins/linked-orders-for-woocommerce run test:e2e && npm --prefix=plugins/internal-comments run test:e2e && npm --prefix=plugins/locked-payment-methods-for-woocommerce run test:e2e
scripts.test:all: composer test:integration && npm run test:e2e && composer plugins:test && npm run plugins:test:e2e
scripts.quality-check:all: composer quality-check && npm run lint && npm run test:e2e && composer plugins:quality-check && npm run plugins:lint && npm run plugins:test:e2e
